# Visit Lisboa

> > Official tourism portal for Lisbon and surrounding regions, managed by Turismo de Lisboa, featuring attractions, events, cultural routes, and the Lisboa Card.

Visit Lisboa serves as the comprehensive guide to Portugal's capital city, covering neighborhoods like Belém, Alfama, Chiado, and Bairro Alto, as well as nearby destinations including Sintra, Mafra, and Ericeira. The site also manages premium event venues at historic locations like Praça do Comércio (Terreiro do Paço).

## Key Topics

- Turismo de Lisboa
- Lisboa Card
- Belém
- Terreiro do Paço
- Fado
- Sintra
- Lisboa Centro
- Praça do Comércio
- Cultural routes
- Event venues
- Alfama
- Chiado
- Bairro Alto
- Historic monuments
- Lisbon attractions

## Getting Started

- [Lisboa OFFICIAL Site | Visit Lisboa](https://www.visitlisboa.com/): Official Lisbon tourism homepage by Turismo de Lisboa with attractions & events
- [Lisboa City Guide](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/regions/lisbon): Comprehensive Lisbon city guide covering culture, beaches, and neighborhoods
- [Traveller information](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/traveller-information): Tourist offices, visitor services, and essential travel info for Lisboa

## Attractions & Activities

- [See & Do](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/p/see-do): Lisbon attractions guide with museums, monuments, and restaurants
- [Lisboa Centro](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/regions/lisboa-centro): Lisboa Centro guide featuring Chiado, Bairro Alto, Alfama, and Fado houses

## Events & Calendar

- [What are you looking for?](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/events): Lisbon events calendar with concerts, festivals, and cultural exhibitions

## Event Venues & Spaces

- [HomeVenues](https://venues.visitlisboa.com/eng/): Event venues at Comércio Square and Terreiro do Paço by Turismo de Lisboa
- [Pátio da Galé](https://venues.visitlisboa.com/eng/pátio-da-galé.html): Pátio da Galé historic venue at Terreiro do Paço for weddings & conferences
- [Sala do Risco](https://venues.visitlisboa.com/eng/sala-do-risco.html): Sala do Risco historic venue at Terreiro do Paço for corporate events

## Optional

- [HomeVenues (PT)](https://venues.visitlisboa.com/): Historic Praça do Comércio venue rental for events in Lisboa
- [HomeVenues (Index)](https://venues.visitlisboa.com/eng/index.html): Premium event spaces at Comércio Square including Pátio da Galé
- [Lisboa OFFICIAL Site (PT-EN)](https://www.visitlisboa.com/pt-pt?lang=en): Official Lisboa tourism site featuring Belém, Fado, and Lisboa Card info
